data.body: 2026-09-26: desktop/src-tauri/target/debug had grown to 142.64 GB (87,894 files); cleaned to 0.574 GB, keeping only 8 hand-made aworkit-desktop snapshot .exe files. Before: incremental/ 77.5 GB (307 cargo session dirs, 131 aworkit_desktop, each ~250 MB dominated by 110-141 MB dep-graph.bin), deps/ 56.4 GB (1944 rlibs incl. many stale ~430-496 MB libaworkit_desktop; 171 PDBs incl. 40+ ~440-527 MB aworkit_desktop PDBs), build/ 5.3 GB, uplifted root artifacts 3.1 GB. No cargo/rustc was running; the app runs from target/release. target/ still holds 306 sibling per-run target dirs from QA/agent runs (40.8 GB left, compaction-build 14.67 GB alone). profile.dev has no overrides (default full debuginfo + incremental) - consider debug=line-tables-only, incremental=false, periodic cargo clean, retention for per-run target dirs.
